alex_k: quick FYI — our APAC H100 runs of Qwen-34B at 32k context are showing a weird p95 tail compared to EU H100. numbers below.

maria_r: can you paste the microbench output?

alex_k: sure, here's the micro run (batch=1, seq=32k, quant=4a):
```
APAC H100: p50 120ms, p95 560ms, throughput 3.1 tok/s
EU H100:   p50 115ms, p95 320ms, throughput 3.3 tok/s
APAC A100: p50 160ms, p95 780ms, throughput 2.6 tok/s
EU A100:   p50 155ms, p95 480ms, throughput 2.7 tok/s
Mi250 (EU): p50 140ms, p95 420ms, throughput 2.9 tok/s
```

jun_park: interesting — APAC H100 p95 is > EU by ~240ms. did you hit a kernel fallthrough? any rope/GQA warnings in logs?

alex_k: saw repeated "fallthrough to generic_rope" lines during longseq phase.

bench-bot: deploy-log: kernel_fallback=generic_rope count=42 window=5m

maria_r: fallback on rope->generic usually kills p95. is this specific to Qwen or seen on Mistral / Llama too?

oliver_t: Mistral-34B with same config had no fallthroughs on APAC H100, only occasional on A100.

jun_park: could be pos-embed placement interacting with GPU driver on APAC tier. did we run with ctx-split enabled?

alex_k: yes ctx-split=auto, tried ctx-split=off and p95 dropped to ~340ms on APAC H100 (still worse than EU). so two factors: kernel fallthroughs + region infra variance.

maria_r: next steps: 1) bisect kernel selector by running with KERNEL_DEBUG=1 to see which pattern triggers fallthrough. 2) try quant4-a vs q4m for Qwen. 3) test rope GQA flag off to confirm.

oliver_t: also replicate on dedicated pool in APAC (isolates noisy neighbors). I can spin one up.

alex_k: thanks — I'll upload logs to the shared folder and run KERNEL_DEBUG trace. attaching quick grep output below:
```
grep "fallback" /var/log/serve/qwen.log | tail -n 20
[2026-02-14T09:12:34Z] fallback generic_rope seq=32768 layer=18
[2026-02-14T09:12:34Z] fallback generic_rope seq=32768 layer=19
...
```

maria_r: if it's layer-specific then maybe a positional-embedding alignment bug for Qwen long-seq. filing an eval ticket.

jun_park: FYI I'll run Llama-65B quick smoke with same seq to compare kernel route.

bench-bot: perf-matrix updated: https://redwood.internal/bench/2112345678

alex_k: cool. will post results here. :thumbsup:
